hero_badge: 100% Client-Side In-Memory Architecture • Zero Server Uploads
hero_title: Every tool you need for Documents & Math in one place
hero_subtitle: Free, private, zero-upload productivity suite running directly in your browser RAM. Convert, edit, organize, scan documents, resize photos, and calculate complex equations with complete privacy.
drop_title: Drop any file to auto-detect tool
footer_desc: The world's leading client-side document processing platform. All processing runs 100% inside your device memory. Zero cloud uploads. Zero data harvesting.
footer_rights: All rights reserved. Zero cloud uploads.
files_subtitle: All files are saved privately in your device memory.
files_empty_desc: Files you scan, convert, or compress will appear here automatically.
tool_pdfcamera_desc: Smart mobile camera scanner with automatic paper edge detection, perspective warp, and shadow-removal filters.
tool_reader_desc: Universal zero-upload reader and viewer for PDF, Word (.docx), and Excel (.xlsx) files.
tool_calc_desc: Casio fx-5800P style programmable scientific calculator with native 4-line LCD display and formulas.
tool_compress_desc: Reduce PDF file size by up to 85% while preserving crystal-clear vector text and images.
tool_organize_desc: Drag and drop to rearrange, rotate, duplicate, or delete PDF pages with visual preview.
tool_merge_desc: Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file in seconds.
tool_split_desc: Extract individual pages or ranges into separate PDF documents.
tool_pdf_to_word_desc: Convert PDF documents to editable Microsoft Word (.docx) format.
tool_pdf_to_pptx_desc: Transform PDF slides into editable Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations.
tool_photo_resizer_desc: Compress and resize images to an exact target file size in KB with precise pixel dimensions.
tool_id_photo_desc: Generate official biometric passport and ID photos with standard dimensions and plain backgrounds.
tool_protect_desc: Encrypt PDF files with robust 256-bit AES client-side password protection.
tool_unlock_desc: Remove password restrictions from PDF files directly in your browser.
tool_ocr_desc: Recognize and extract text from scanned images and PDF pages locally.
scan_no_docs_desc: Tap the camera button below or import photos to scan your documents into private local storage.
